title: Want to code your own strategy & Indicator?
author: AcanthocephalaNo6605
selftext:
While25: A programmable trading platform that directly connects to your broker feed and routes real orders from your workspace.

It contains advanced charting, a smart order routing system, an inbuilt code editor, and an AI assistant that can work along with you. It comes with an inbuilt Python SDK to design your custom algorithm, indicator, dashboard, and even ML/DL models.

We are rolling out our initial build to users tomorrow at https://while25.com.

comments.author: Shoddy_Peanut7320
comments.body:
Re "Want to code your own strategy & Indicator?":

Bundling charting, order routing, code editor and AI assistant into one workspace is an ambitious scope for an initial build, worth being upfront with early users about which pieces are most battle-tested vs newest, since an all-in-one platform rolling out for the first time usually has its rough edges concentrated in whichever component was built last. The Python SDK for custom algos/ML models is the more differentiated piece versus most competitors who stick to Pine-style DSLs, curious how you're handling backtest-to-live parity, since that's usually where Python-based systems either shine (real statistical libraries, proper vectorized backtesting) or quietly diverge (live execution behaving differently than the backtest simulated, especially around fills and slippage assumptions). Worth flagging clearly in the rollout post whether day-one users get real order routing or should start in a paper/sandbox mode first, given it's an initial build going live tomorrow.

Similar space to what I've been building with EventTrader, curious to see how the initial rollout goes. [https://claude.ai/artifact/VuwYE2KYrtzMdwyEpvA9wH](https://claude.ai/artifact/VuwYE2KYrtzMdwyEpvA9wH)

replies.author: AcanthocephalaNo6605
replies.body:
Interesting!

Let me start with the most important part which is battle tested!

Order Management System!

Our OMS, chart engine and all the critical components are being built since last one year and python sdk is not part of the engine directly. Because we dont want to make any strategy or backtesting harness (we built it and spent significant time there and scrapped it) because then you cant convert your any idea into strategy!

This python sdk allows you to get third party libraries and what we provide in it is unified data plumming and order routing API's. It makes easy for every trader to create indicators/strategies/backtests and dashboards with just prompts.

Unless user has got wrong code and deployed it platform will remain stable and deterministic. Although you will have to keep app open until your strategy is running!
